files.report.py:
"""Print the nightly reservations report for Fenwick Tool Library.

The lending feed writes one dated file per month into downloads/:

    reservations-<year>-<month>.csv

The report covers the newest month in downloads/, one line per day that
has reservations, in date order, followed by a total line:

    <day>,<reservations>
    TOTAL,<reservations>
"""

import csv

rows = list(csv.reader(open("downloads/reservations.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8")))[1:]
per_day = {}
for row in rows:
    day = row[1]
    per_day[day] = per_day.get(day, 0) + 1

total = 0
for day in sorted(per_day):
    print(f"{day},{per_day[day]}")
    total += per_day[day]
print(f"TOTAL,{total}")

month after next; the nightly report covers the newest month only.
